name: WebMD
summary:
WebMD is the health-information site at webmd.com. The blue cross mark in the tab is the icon symptom-page bookmarks use, saved from that host.

Checked 12 November 2026 against webmd.com. HTML came from https://www.webmd.com/ (HTTP 200). Icon link tags: shortcut icon → https://img.lb.wbmdstatic.com/vim/live/webmd/consumer_assets/site_images/favicon/favicon.png; apple-touch-icon → https://img.lb.wbmdstatic.com/vim/live/webmd/consumer_assets/site_images/favicon/favicon_144.png.

The favicon.ico URL is https://img.webmd.com/dtmcms/live/webmd/consumer_assets/site_images/favicon/webmd.ico. The saved file favicon.ico is 9662 bytes. Directory sizes: 48×48.

The apple-touch-icon URL is https://img.lb.wbmdstatic.com/vim/live/webmd/consumer_assets/site_images/favicon/favicon_144.png, measured at 144×144 webp.

No brand colour could be derived. The page had no theme-color, mask-icon colour, or manifest theme_color, and a dominant pixel colour was not readable from the saved PNGs.

Largest measured bitmap: webp-144x144-01.webp at 144×144 (webp, 2722 bytes) from https://img.lb.wbmdstatic.com/vim/live/webmd/consumer_assets/site_images/favicon/favicon_144.png.
